_comment: The resource a capability names an object by, object://{tenant}/{collection segment}/{key}, which the server (objecth.CapabilityObjectURI), the Go SDK (paladin.ObjectResource) and the Python SDK (paladin.object_resource) build alike. The collection is one URI segment, its '/' written '.' as the bucket path writes it (storagepath.CollectionSegment), so every (collection, key) has a URI of its own and a grant on a collection does not reach a nested one. An empty key is the collection's own prefix, which a grant on the whole collection names. Under covers, a grant on (collection, key prefix) reaches an object when limes.MatchResource matches their URIs; the Python fake's matcher is held to the same rows.

covers.name: a collection covers its own object
a collection does not cover a nested collection's object
a nested collection covers its own object
a nested collection does not cover its parent's object
a key prefix covers the keys under it
a key prefix does not cover a nested collection named alike
a collection does not cover one that starts with its name

_reach_comment: What a capability's resource prefix, as stored, reaches under limes.MatchResource: every object in matches is covered and none in misses is. In a prefix {tenant} is the capability's tenant, {TENANT} its id in upper case and {other_tenant} another tenant; an object names its tenant only when it is not {tenant}. reach is how the console words the prefix: all_tenants, tenant, other_tenant, collection, keys (under a prefix ending in /), key (that key and the keys under it), nothing, or unknown (no object resource, which the console does not read).

reach.name: the scheme alone reaches every tenant's objects
a scheme cut before its slashes still reaches every object
a tenant without its slash reaches every collection of it
a tenant with its slash reaches every collection of it
a collection without its slash reaches the whole collection
a collection without its slash does not reach a nested one
a nested collection without its slash reaches only itself
a key prefix ending in a slash reaches the keys under it
a key prefix without the slash reaches that key and the keys under it
a segment no collection is written as reaches nothing
another tenant's resource reaches nothing in this one
a tenant id in upper case reaches nothing
a cut tenant id reaches nothing
a key prefix with a dot-dot segment reaches nothing
a key prefix with an empty segment reaches nothing
a path that is no object resource reaches no object
a key prefix with a percent-encoded dot-dot segment reaches nothing
a key prefix with a dot-dot segment before path parameters reaches nothing
